t0337-01.gloss: Field residue and response material meet in one ambiguous personal bundle.
t0337-01.rival_reading: Field workers or an emergency crew could have assembled this bundle; the mixed residue and road tape do not show which came first.

t0337-02.gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
t0337-02.rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
